title: Accounts Assistant
description:

Month-End Support: Assist with journal entries, accruals, prepayments, and trial balance preparations.

Reporting & Compliance: Help prepare quarterly VAT returns and compile data for annual statutory audits.

Query Resolution: Act as a main point of contact for internal and external supplier or customer account queries.

Intercompany recharges - calculate and raise recharge invoices

title: Credit Controller
description:
Credit Controller

Eccles/Hybrid

Know how to collect cash without damaging customer relationships?

We're recruiting for three experienced Credit Controllers to join a well-established, market-leading business during an exciting period of transformation.

This is a fantastic opportunity for commercially minded Credit Controllers who enjoy taking ownership of their ledger, building strong customer relationships and making a tangible impact on business performance.

- Investigating and resolving invoice, account and payment queries to prevent delays

- Managing failed payments and ensuring appropriate action is taken
- Working closely with Sales, Customer Services and Operational teams to support collections activity

- Supporting debt escalation and recovery processes where required

Proven experience in a Credit Control position

Strong understanding of cash collection, debt recovery and credit risk management

Excellent negotiation and relationship-building skills

Commercial awareness and the confidence to make informed decisions

Ability to manage a busy ledger and prioritise effectively

Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive mindset

High levels of accuracy and attention to detail

SAP experience would be advantageous

Why Join?

This is an opportunity to join a secure, growing business where Credit Control is recognised as a key function. You'll be part of a supportive team that values collaboration, initiative and results.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Credit Controller

Paying £25k - £28k DOE
Based in Manchester City
5 days on site

We're looking for a confident, motivated and commercially minded Credit Controller to join a fast-paced and supportive team.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working with people, is comfortable having conversations around payments and arrears, and takes pride in achieving results without compromising on customer service.

You'll take ownership of your own portfolio and daily collection activity, working closely with colleagues across the business to resolve queries, manage accounts and maximise cash collection. You'll also have the opportunity to make a real impact on the wider performance of the credit function.

What you'll be doing
- Managing your own daily collection schedule and taking responsibility for achieving individual targets.
- Making outbound collection calls, with telephone contact being the preferred first point of contact.
- Working towards and exceeding agreed KPIs and SLAs across cash collection and customer contact.
- Managing outstanding balances and supporting the rescheduling of arrears where appropriate.
- Monitoring account activity and aged debt, identifying trends and taking action where required.
- Escalating account queries where they require further support or fall outside your remit.
- Building strong relationships with internal stakeholders to ensure issues are dealt with quickly and professionally.
- Contributing to a positive team environment and supporting colleagues when needed.
- Identifying any areas where additional training or coaching would be beneficial.
- Keeping on top of activity levels, including calls, call time and email queues, and being able to explain any significant changes or variances in performance.

What we're looking for

You'll ideally have previous experience in Credit Control, Collections, Customer Service or a similar customer-facing environment.

More importantly, you'll be someone who:
- Is confident, positive and an excellent communicator.
- Is comfortable speaking to customers about payments and resolving difficult conversations professionally.
- Has strong negotiation and influencing skills.
- Takes ownership of their workload and is accountable for their results.
- Works well under pressure and enjoys working in a busy, changing environment.
- Is target-driven but understands the importance of delivering a great customer experience.
- Is reliable, punctual and committed to maintaining high standards.

What success looks like

You'll play an important role in the overall performance of the credit function, with success measured across areas including:
- Cash collection and collection efficiency.
- Reduction and movement of aged debt.
- Debtor days.
- Rescheduling of arrears.
- Direct Debit coverage.
- Outbound call activity.
- Achievement of agreed KPIs and SLAs.
- Quality of customer interactions and resolution of queries.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys a role where no two days are quite the same, likes being measured on results and wants to be part of a team where their contribution genuinely matters.
